items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Well I learned him a little bit, I learned on banjo

ctx.x: Now Percy's affair, when I lived on Robinson Street, I was working at a food company, well I took with a stroke in my arm. Well I learned him a little bit, I learned on banjo and he come back here with handing them from out of Baton Rouge, he was playing more banjo than I was, you know what I was. And he played with a, last time I read music, he was up there in Bill Platt or somewhere, he's on piano now. Well I heard he was in that just for a while.
I wanted to be looking for him in that just for a while.
